title: P0492 - P0492
models: Audi A4 / VW Passat / Skoda Octavia
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları or relay for Secondary Air Injection Pump faulty
Hose(s)/Piping between Secondary Air Injection Pump and Combi (Secondary Air Injection) Valve leaking
Secondary Air Injection Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri faulty
Secondary Air Injection ports in the cylinder head(s) plugged with carbon See VAG Grubu Özel Servis ve Kronik Notları
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  fuse and relay for Secondary Air Injection Pump system.
Kontrol edin:  hose(s)/Piping between Secondary Air Injection Pump and Combi Valve
Kontrol edin:  Secondary Air Injection Solenoid(s)
Kontrol edin:  Secondary Air Injection Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri
Temizleyin:  Secondary Air Injection ports in the cylinder head(s) if obstructed with carbon See VAG Grubu Özel Servis ve Kronik Notları
technicalNotes:
When found in most NAR (North American Market) 2009 to 2016 Audi models with 3.0L or 3.2L engines with P0491 and P0492 stored at same time, check to see if TPI 2033001 is applicable.
